summary: Cycle-end self_model review must be best-effort and timeout-bounded; it cannot be allowed to block daemon state persistence or the next scheduling cycle.
symptoms: run_forever.after_tick appears but tick.before_status_write is delayed for many minutes
daemon reaches cycle-end reflection while last_tick_at remains stale and watchdog pressure increases
self_model review becomes the only remaining blocker after tick body and status cache logic are otherwise healthy

preferred_fix.strategy: run self_model at cycle end with a strict timeout and degrade to a static operator_attention summary when the review exceeds the budget
